results.summary: WilfTT is an 8-bit counter design that increments on each clock cycle. It is implemented in Wokwi and runs at 1 Hz. The design is tested by pressing play in the simulation. The project lacks detailed documentation, so its specific operation and any external hardware requirements are unclear.

This project implements a 3-bit ALU that can perform AND, OR, XOR, and ADD operations based on a 2-bit opcode. It uses an 8-input DIP switch to set the A and B inputs and LEDs to display the outputs. The design is implemented in Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes. The ALU is combinational, producing results directly from the inputs.

TT-wokwi-template is a design based on the Wokwi template that increments a counter from 0 to 9 on a screen when a STEP button is pressed. The design is implemented in Wokwi and is intended as a template for educational purposes. The documentation is minimal, and the design may be incomplete. The project lacks detailed information about its operation and external hardware requirements.

This project takes two 4-bit inputs, adds them, and displays the result on a seven-segment display. The inputs are provided via DIP switches, and the outputs include seven-segment control signals plus a decimal point. The design is implemented in Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes. The adder is combinational, producing the display output directly from the inputs.
